notice: Educational practice library generated for CyberIQ. These are reference-solved labs, not claims that the portfolio owner personally completed third-party CTF challenges.

challenges.title: Caesar Shift 1
challenges.scenario: Recover plaintext from a rotation cipher.
challenges.solution: Try all 26 rotations and select the readable candidate.
challenges.lesson: Brute-force the tiny keyspace; validate language.

challenges.title: Base64 Layers 1
challenges.scenario: Unwrap repeatedly encoded text.
challenges.solution: Identify Base64 alphabet and decode layer by layer.
challenges.lesson: Encoding is reversible representation, not encryption.

challenges.title: XOR Single Byte 1
challenges.scenario: Recover text protected by one-byte XOR.
challenges.solution: Score all 256 candidate keys for readable plaintext.
challenges.lesson: Small XOR keyspaces are exhaustively searchable.

challenges.title: RSA Small Exponent 1
challenges.scenario: Analyze weak RSA challenge parameters.
challenges.solution: Inventory n, e, c; test only the mathematical condition supplied by the lab.
challenges.lesson: RSA attacks depend on a specific weakened assumption.

challenges.title: Vigenere Clue 1
challenges.scenario: Recover a Vigenere message using a supplied clue.
challenges.solution: Use the clue as key material and validate the decoded phrase.
challenges.lesson: Known key material collapses classical-cipher secrecy.

challenges.title: Image Landmark 1
challenges.scenario: Identify a landmark from challenge-provided visual clues.
challenges.solution: Extract visible signs, architecture, and contextual clues; corroborate with public sources.
challenges.lesson: Corroborate multiple independent clues.

challenges.title: Username Pivot 1
challenges.scenario: Correlate a fictional challenge alias across supplied public profiles.
challenges.solution: Search the exact alias and compare non-sensitive challenge attributes.
challenges.lesson: A matching username alone is not identity proof.

challenges.title: Metadata Trail 1
challenges.scenario: Use metadata intentionally embedded in a CTF artifact.
challenges.solution: Inspect supplied metadata and verify coordinates/context against public maps.
challenges.lesson: Metadata can reveal unintended context.

challenges.title: Archive Research 1
challenges.scenario: Find a historical version of a challenge page.
challenges.solution: Compare archived snapshots and record timestamps.
challenges.lesson: Web archives preserve evidence that may disappear.

challenges.title: Domain Clues 1
challenges.scenario: Analyze a challenge-owned domain using public registration/DNS clues.
challenges.solution: Collect public DNS/registration facts and correlate only challenge-relevant fields.
challenges.lesson: Public infrastructure metadata can establish relationships.

challenges.title: Robots Disclosure 1
challenges.scenario: Find a challenge path disclosed by robots.txt.
challenges.solution: Inspect crawler directives and visit only the in-scope disclosed path.
challenges.lesson: robots.txt is not access control.

challenges.title: IDOR Lab 1
challenges.scenario: Test object authorization in a local training app.
challenges.solution: Change only the lab object identifier and compare authorization behavior.
challenges.lesson: Server-side authorization must protect every object.

challenges.title: Header Clue 1
challenges.scenario: Inspect response headers for a challenge hint.
challenges.solution: Review the supplied lab response and identify the intentional hint.
challenges.lesson: Headers can disclose implementation details.

challenges.title: Source Comment 1
challenges.scenario: Find an intentional clue in challenge HTML.
challenges.solution: Inspect page source and follow only the challenge-provided clue.
challenges.lesson: Comments can expose information.

challenges.title: Cookie Logic 1
challenges.scenario: Analyze a deliberately weak lab preference cookie.
challenges.solution: Compare cookie changes in the local challenge and validate server trust boundaries.
challenges.lesson: Security decisions should not trust client-controlled state.

challenges.title: EXIF Hunt 1
challenges.scenario: Inspect a supplied image for challenge metadata.
challenges.solution: Read EXIF fields, preserve the original, and validate relevant fields.
challenges.lesson: Preserve originals before deriving evidence.

challenges.title: Spectrogram Message 1
challenges.scenario: Reveal a message encoded in challenge audio.
challenges.solution: Render a spectrogram and inspect the intended visual pattern.
challenges.lesson: Frequency-domain views can expose hidden structure.

challenges.title: File Carving 1
challenges.scenario: Recover an embedded file from a supplied lab artifact.
challenges.solution: Identify signatures, carve derived data, and hash outputs.
challenges.lesson: Keep derived artifacts separate from originals.

challenges.title: Magic Bytes 1
challenges.scenario: Identify a mislabeled challenge file.
challenges.solution: Compare extension with file signature and parse accordingly.
challenges.lesson: Extensions are labels, not proof of format.

challenges.title: Log Timeline 1
challenges.scenario: Reconstruct events from a small supplied log set.
challenges.solution: Normalize timestamps and order relevant events.
challenges.lesson: Timeline consistency is evidence.

challenges.title: Strings First 1
challenges.scenario: Recover an intentional clue from a toy binary.
challenges.solution: Inspect printable strings before deeper analysis.
challenges.lesson: Start with the least invasive useful technique.

challenges.title: Branch Logic 1
challenges.scenario: Understand a simple validation branch in a training binary.
challenges.solution: Trace comparisons and express the condition in pseudocode.
challenges.lesson: Reason about control flow before patching.

challenges.title: Encoded Constant 1
challenges.scenario: Decode a constant embedded in a toy program.
challenges.solution: Identify the reversible transform and reproduce it safely.
challenges.lesson: Static constants can reveal program intent.

challenges.title: Function Map 1
challenges.scenario: Map functions in a small educational binary.
challenges.solution: Identify entry point, callers, and validation routine.
challenges.lesson: A function map reduces analysis noise.

challenges.title: State Machine 1
challenges.scenario: Reconstruct a toy state machine.
challenges.solution: Trace transitions and document valid input sequence.
challenges.lesson: State transitions expose validation logic.
